items.label: Portuguese 25 or 26 or 27
items.notes: Select one course. Portuguese 27 is recommended.

requirement.label: Honors Program
requirement.notes: Portuguese 198A is a 4-unit course in which students research and prepare a draft of a thesis on a selected topic; Portuguese 198B is 2-unit course in which students complete the final thesis draft of approximately 25 to 30 pages.

items.label: Linguistics and Literature Core Courses
items.notes: Select Portuguese 100A or 100B or another course from 100-199; one additional course from Portuguese 100-199; and two additional courses from Portuguese courses 100-199. All courses must be taken in Portuguese and be a minimum of 4 units.

items.label: Upper-Division Elective Courses
items.notes: Complete six elective courses selected from Portuguese 100 through 199; taught in either English or Portuguese and a minimum of 4 units.

nodes.title: Intermediate Portuguese
nodes.description: Lecture, three hours; laboratory, two hours. Taught in Portuguese. Laboratory is online. Intermediate Portuguese language and culture course that is proficiency-oriented, communicative, and task-based to help develop communicative competence in four skill areas (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), as well as cultural competence. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Intensive Portuguese
nodes.description: Lecture, four hours; laboratory, two hours. Taught in Portuguese. Laboratory is online. Accelerated course designed only for students with proficiency in another Romance language. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Advanced Portuguese
groups: Preparation for the Major: Portuguese 25 or 26 or 27
nodes.description: Lecture, three hours. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Language and Popular Culture
groups: Preparation for the Major: Portuguese 25 or 26 or 27
nodes.description: Lecture, three hours. Development of speaking, reading, and writing skills. Structured in thematic units, with songs, videos, and specific vocabulary emphasizing questions of Brazilian cultural identity. Letter grading.

nodes.title: Writing Studies: Afro-Luso-Brazilian World
groups: Preparation for the Major: Portuguese 25 or 26 or 27
nodes.description: Lecture, three hours. Further development of communicative skills, especially writing. Discussions and activities increase knowledge and ability to comprehend variety of forms of cultural production in Portuguese language. Students continue to acquire cultural competence. Introduction to study of literature, with specific focus on themes and topics pertinent to Lusophone world. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Portuguese, Brazilian, and African Literature in Translation: Portuguese and Portuguese-African Literature
groups: Preparation for the Major: Portuguese 40A or 40B or 46
nodes.description: Lecture, three hours. Reading and discussion of selected works in translation. Papers and examinations in English. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Portuguese, Brazilian, and African Literature in Translation: Brazilian Literature
groups: Preparation for the Major: Portuguese 40A or 40B or 46
nodes.description: Lecture, four hours. Reading and discussion of selected works in translation. Papers and examinations in English. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Brazil and Portuguese-Speaking World
groups: Preparation for the Major: Portuguese 40A or 40B or 46
nodes.description: Lecture, four hours; discussion, one hour (when scheduled). Taught in English. Topical analysis of cultural history of Brazil in context of Portuguese-speaking world, with emphasis on comparative, trans-Atlantic relations, social development, and artistic manifestations. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Phonology and Morphology
groups: The Major: Linguistics and Literature Core Courses
nodes.description: Lecture, four hours. Analysis of phonetic, phonemic, and morphological systems of Portuguese. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Syntax
groups: The Major: Linguistics and Literature Core Courses
nodes.description: Lecture, four hours. Review of patterns of Portuguese language. P/NP or letter grading.

nodes.title: Senior Honors Research in Portuguese I
nodes.description: Tutorial, to be arranged. Preparation: completion of minimum of six upper-division major core courses with 3.7 grade-point average. Course 198A is enforced Limited to juniors/seniors. Development and completion of honors thesis under direct supervision of faculty member. May not be applied toward major requirements. Individual contract required. Letter grading.

nodes.title: Senior Honors Research in Portuguese II
nodes.description: Tutorial, to be arranged. Preparation: completion of minimum of six upper-division major core courses with 3.7 grade-point average. Limited to juniors/seniors. Development and completion of honors thesis under direct supervision of faculty member. May not be applied toward major requirements. Individual contract required. Letter grading.
